evidence_policy: Exact model runtime evidence is authoritative for current-account executability. Core Ark API documentation may establish API-surface compatibility. Generic wrappers/product articles remain lower-tier for exact duration/control limits unless causally isolated.

first_last_frame.notes: Core Ark API explicitly supports return_last_frame for output chaining, but that does not itself prove explicit first+last-frame input-role support for this exact model.

epistemic_limits: Single-image I2V is exact current-account E2E, but identity/detail consistency reliability is probabilistic and unmeasured.
First-last-frame input remains an unexecuted candidate even though return_last_frame output chaining is documented at the API level.
Maximum duration remains modality-specific and unknown beyond the 5-second E2E domain.
Do not promote one latency sample or 1080p/246840-token observations into stable rankings or universal rules.

production_strategy.continuity_note: return_last_frame may be used as a documented output mechanism for chaining, but the next-task input semantics still follow the tested single-image path unless explicit first/last roles are separately proven.
